name: Multi-horizon momentum alignment breakout
hypothesis: A breakout on the trading timeframe works better when 15-minute, 1-hour and 4-hour momentum all point the same way.

entry.long: tf("15m", roc(close,8)) > 0 and tf("1h", roc(close,6)) > 0 and tf("4h", roc(close,6)) > 0 and close > highest(high,12)[1]
entry.short: tf("15m", roc(close,8)) < 0 and tf("1h", roc(close,6)) < 0 and tf("4h", roc(close,6)) < 0 and close < lowest(low,12)[1]

evidence.note: time-series momentum at 1-12 month horizons (not intraday)
